title: Chameleon
body:
# Chameleon

This mod is **heavily** inspired by [Meccha Chameleon](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704690/MECCHA_CHAMELEON/), huge thanks to the team behind it!

1. Make sure to set the correct keybind for the paint tool, it is by default set to **P**
2. **/chameleon** is the only command for the mod, it is OP only and will let you play with your friends.

In **Chameleon**, hiders disguise themselves to blend into the world. Open the built-in paint editor and decorate your own skin to match whatever's around you. The closer your paint matches the texture next to you, the higher the chance of winning.

Once the timer is over, the game starts, hide yourself somewhere in the world and wait.

For seekers, F3+B and nametags are disabled. They have to hunt without any external tools.

## How a match runs

One player hosts, through the setting menu, they set the spawn points, assign who hides and who seeks, and start the round. Hiders go first to paint and position themselves while a timer counts down. Seekers are frozen until the clock hits zero, then they're loosed to comb the map. One tag catches a hider. The last hider left wins.

## Built for multiplayer

Chameleon runs on servers right out of the box. Match controls are operator-only, so hosting stays in trusted hands.


# How to start?
Open chat and run the command: ```/chameleon``` to open the game hosting panel.
From there, choose your settings and have fun!
